description: Milestone 3 (README Part III), with the amodal mask: LidarFit for ITODD obj 26 (tee connector) with the six chart twinchers of milestone 2 after noise post-training (noise_charts.py), the visible silhouette enforced (fill_visib, also in the solver's target) and p clamped to the trained box |p_k| <= 0.86. Paths are relative to this file.

decisions.parameters: p0 -> distance D (mm), p1 -> elevation e, p2 -> azimuth phi, p3 -> roll psi about a centre c; ChartZ: elevation above the plane perpendicular to the model Z axis, azimuth 0 along -X, pi/2 along +Y, image up = model +Z at roll 0; ChartY: the same with Y (azimuth 0 along +X, pi/2 along +Z); roll centres 0, +-2pi/3 (charts 0, 1, 2), half-width 5pi/12; every view lies in some chart with |p|_inf <= 0.857 (train_chart.py).
decisions.stencil: Fourier-Bessel: 63 components of the heights above a background 20 mm behind the mean depth of the mask, about its centre of mass, damped exp(-(n/3)^2), ISRU(12 x), plus the depth component ISRU(6 (Z_mean - Z_mid) / (Z_bg - Z_lo)); 512^2 rendering; finite-difference step 0.025.
decisions.charts: all six charts and both attempts (Newton and plain step of the fused solver) are solved from p = 0; the solution with the smallest misfit (RMS of the y-tone difference on the known pixels of map_avail) is kept.
decisions.real images and stencil centre: as for the cylinder (lidarfit_obj12_m1.json): virtual camera through the centre of mass of the mask, resampling into the stencil square, unknown pixels from the rendering (fused target), com_track with the fused silhouette, image borders as unknown pixels.
decisions.visible silhouette: on the test images most unknown pixels of the object are holes of the sensor inside mask_visib (median 24 % of the amodal mask; occluded: 1 %); unknown, they took the rendering, so a solution that slid off them was not penalized. fill_visib: they count as object (known), with the rendered depth, or with the depth of the nearest observed pixels of mask_visib where the rendering misses them; fill_target: also in the target of the solver (not only in the misfit and the centre).
decisions.post-training: each chart twincher continued with hs_sm_noise (amp 1e-3, y_range 0.05), the recipe's hs loss and whole-domain trimmer as guard rails, R held at 0.86, primed restart, momentum reset (chart_training.MomentumReset); ChartZ0: eta (median |dp| / |noise| for noise normal to the manifold) 0.73 -> 0.25, val MSSD of its instances halved.
